text:
olga: Quick sync — we have four docs PRs blocking the v0.9.2 roll (changelog + SDK snippets + migration guide + mkdocs fix). Need reviewer assignment so CI previews don't sit stale.
ryan: I can take the SDK snippets PRs but heads-up I’m heads-down on infra until 3pm.
maya: I can do the changelog and migration guide reviews this afternoon.
docs-bot: docs-preview: PR #432 build failed — see logs: `mkdocs.exceptions.ConfigurationError: Page 'sdk/snippets.md' referenced in nav but not found`
sam: I'll pick up the mkdocs error and try to repro locally. Assign to me.
jeremy: We keep hitting this gap where nobody is owning quick docs fixes. Can we make a short rotation or tag-based assignment?
olga: Proposal: one-week lightweight rotation with two roles: "snippets/guides" and "changelog/migrations". Each role has 1 primary and 1 backup. Commitment = triage + preview + merge if green.
ryan: I’ll be primary for snippets/guides this week (PRs 428, 431). Backup?
maya: I’ll be primary for changelog/migrations. I can be backup for snippets if needed.
sam: OK I'll be backup for mkdocs/infra related docs fixes. Will start on PR#432 now.
docs-bot: docs-preview: PR #430 succeeded — preview: https://docs-preview.internal/430 :white_check_mark:
ryan: Quick tip for #431 — use `mkdocs build --strict` locally; it catches missing nav refs before pushing.
maya: Can we also add a tiny reviewer checklist in CONTRIBUTING.md (preview link + run examples)? I'll open a tiny PR for that.
jeremy: +1 to the checklist. Also suggest labels `docs-reviewer/<name>` so assignments are clearer in PR list.
olga: Assignments for this thread: ryan -> snippets (PRs 428,431), sam -> mkdocs fix (PR 432), maya -> changelog + migration (PR 429). I've added `docs-reviewer/olga` temporarily to track until labels exist.
ryan: ack. I’ll review 428 first thing after 3pm and ping when preview is green.
sam: fixing mkdocs nav now; will paste the minimal patch here when done.
maya: I'll open the tiny checklist PR and tag the rotation doc in the handbook.
olga: Cool — please update PR labels with `docs-reviewer/<name>` and add a short comment in each PR with preview link when green. We'll slot a 15m follow-up Friday to see coverage. Thanks all :rocket:
